name: Activity Calendar
title: Activities by date, with places per person
ask: What is on this Saturday, and are there places for three?
covers: the activities on offer, their dates and prices, who they suit, what to bring and where to meet
rule: Never say a place is booked or held: the organiser confirms every request. Never take payment or card details in the chat.
who: Organisers that run activities on set dates: outdoor and adventure providers, workshops and classes, community and resort activity programmes. A tour operator selling trips uses Travel & Tourism.
author: BizPlug

page.headline: Your activity calendar, answered and requested in the chat
page.problem: People ask what is on and whether there is room, usually when nobody is at the desk. A plug-in shows your activities on a calendar with the price per person for each date, answers what to bring and where to meet, and sends the request for places to you to confirm.
valueProps: A calendar of what is on::Each open date with its lowest price per person.
Prices by date::A weekday, weekend or holiday rate, as you publish it.
Requests you confirm::The activity, the date and the number of people, ready to confirm.
moments: This Saturday::The activities open that day, with the price for three.
The school holiday::Dates you marked as full are shown as full.
What do I bring?::Your own answers, from the information you publish.
Did we get in?::A reference check instead of a call.
journeys: Pick a date and the number of people
faqs: Are places held in the chat?::No. You confirm every request. Dates are full when you publish them as taken; it is not a live booking system.
Does it take payment?::No. It never takes payment or card details. You arrange payment when confirming.
